author: FaZeDuckwaterloo
body:
Hey guys I'm new to the Avicus network and community and I'm very excited. I love to play with my mates and play competitively. I've been playing on MeepCraft mainly for a lot of my time for around 3 and half years!!!!!! My friend D0OZiE showed me this server and said it was a great server. I'm so excited to meet more people. For short you can call me Ducks. I'm 15 years old and I live Connecticut, I am a freshman in highschool. My real name is John Smith, but my friends like to call me Josh, I don't know why though xdddddd. Anyways glad to be in this server and if you want to talk to me I'll be in the TeamSpeak open to talk to everyone.
